copy.failed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it.

online.label: Online
online.blurb: A code or link for your website. Works today.

inStore.label: In store
inStore.blurb: A live voucher members show at your till.

both.label: Both
both.blurb: One reward. Members use it either way.

staffScan.label: Staff scan
staffScan.blurb: Staff scan the voucher on powr.life/scan, from any phone or a tablet at the till.

look.label: Look at the screen
look.blurb: Staff check the live voucher and swipe it on the member’s phone. Nothing to set up.

tillBarcode.label: Till barcode
tillBarcode.blurb: Members show one of your own barcodes and your till scans it. For chains.

comingSoon.title: In store is coming soon
comingSoon.body: Members will be able to use your rewards at your till with a live voucher. We'll let you know when it's ready for your shops.

page.title: Your shops
page.intro: Members claim a reward with their points, then show a live voucher at your till. It changes every few seconds, so a screenshot won't work.
page.loadFailedBody: {{error}} Nothing on your account has changed.

steps.addShopHint: Add each shop with a pin on the map, so members see where to use your rewards.
steps.turnOnHint: Pick a reward and choose In store or Both.
steps.tillHint: Give each member of staff their own scan link, or open the scan page on a till tablet.
steps.done: You're ready. Members can use your rewards at the till.

rewards.emptyBody: Create a reward first. Choose "In store" as the delivery and it lands here ready to set up.

memberSteps.claim: Claims the reward with their points.
memberSteps.openAtTill: At your till, opens it and taps Use in store.
memberSteps.scanStand: Scans the POWR stand on your counter.
memberSteps.showForScan: Shows the live voucher. Your staff scan it.
memberSteps.showForSwipe: Shows the live voucher. Your staff check it and swipe.
memberSteps.showBarcode: Shows your barcode. Your till scans it.
memberSteps.orOnline: Or uses the code at your online checkout.
memberSteps.online: Uses the code at your online checkout.

needs.scanPage: powr.life/scan open on a phone, or a tablet at the till
needs.ownLink: Their own scan link, from the Staff tab
needs.look: To know the offer, and to swipe the voucher on the member’s phone
needs.barcode: Nothing new. Your till already takes these codes.
needs.stand: A printed POWR stand on each counter (Sites tab)
needs.online: Nothing. It all happens at your online checkout.

editor.pickShop: Pick at least one shop, or all shops.
editor.saved: Saved. Members see the change straight away.
editor.savedOnline: Saved. This reward is online only.
editor.switchToInStore: Members will stop getting a code for this reward and show a live voucher at your till instead. Codes already claimed still work.
editor.onlineNeedsCodes: Online needs codes. Load them in Promo Codes before members claim this online.
editor.checkTitle: How does your shop check it?
editor.barcodeHelp: Upload your codes in Promo Codes. To confirm which were used, upload the used list from your till in Promo Codes › Reconcile.
editor.standLabel: Members scan your QR stand first
editor.standDetail: Proves the member is in the shop before the voucher opens. Print a stand for each shop in the Sites tab.
editor.spendDetail: Staff can type what the member spent, so you see what the offer brings in. They can skip it.
editor.windowHint: Opening it doesn't use it up. If time runs out the member just opens it again.
editor.noShops: You haven't added a shop yet. <add>Add one in Sites</add> so members see where to use it.
editor.allShops: All shops, including ones you add later

sites.rotateConfirm: Make a new stand for {{name}}? The stand you printed before stops working, so print and swap the new one straight away.
sites.emptyBody: Add each shop with its pin on the map. Members see which shops take your rewards, and each shop gets its own counter stand.
sites.radius: Members within {{radius}} m count as in the shop.
sites.standSize: A5, for the counter. Unique to this shop.
sites.replaceTitle: Replace a lost or copied stand
sites.turnOnHint: Turn a reward on in the Rewards tab.

siteEditor.noGeolocation: This browser can’t share its location.
siteEditor.locationFailed: Couldn’t get your location. Drop the pin on the map instead.
siteEditor.needPin: Drop a pin on the map for this shop
siteEditor.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Members stop seeing it, and its stand stops working.
siteEditor.name: Shop name
siteEditor.radiusLabel: Counts as in the shop within
siteEditor.pinHint: Search, click the map, or paste a link to place the pin.

staff.reissueConfirm: Make a new link for {{name}}? Their old link stops working.
staff.revokeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Their scan link stops working straight away.
staff.intro: Each person gets their own scan link. They open it once on their phone and it remembers them. A scan link can only check and confirm vouchers: no reports, no settings. Every scan is tied to a person and a shop.
staff.name: Name
staff.linkOnce: Send it to them now. For security it's only shown once; you can make a new one any time.
staff.nobody: Nobody yet. Signed-in portal users can always scan from powr.life/scan.

scanTab.phoneBody: Staff open their own scan link once and they're set. You can open it here too while you're signed in.
scanTab.tablet: On a tablet at the till
scanTab.tabletBody: Kiosk mode does two jobs. It shows a QR that changes every 30 seconds for members to scan, and it scans members' vouchers with the front camera. It also shows today's tally.

report.loadFailed: Couldn't load in-store figures just now.
report.title: In store
report.openedSub: Rewards members opened in your shops
report.spendNone: Staff can add the spend when they scan
report.footnote: Confirmed means your staff scanned the voucher. Swiped means staff swiped it on the member's phone: we count it, but it doesn't prove the discount was given.
report.barcodes: Till barcodes: {{issued}} handed out, {{used}} confirmed from your till report.
report.barcodesReconcile: Upload your used list in Promo Codes › Reconcile to update this.

stand.gone: This shop has been removed, or it belongs to another brand.
stand.printHint: A5, portrait. Use thick card if you can.
stand.headline: Got a POWR reward?
